name: Shippo
label: Shippo REST 2018-02-08 — address, shipment, rate, label, track
description: Shippo multi-carrier labels. Authorization: ShippoToken api_token. Docs: https://docs.goshippo.com/api-reference/shipments/create-a-new-shipment. address_validate uses name/street1/city/zip/country; shipment_create uses address_from, address_to, parcels; label_create uses rate or instalabel shipment. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Never log api_token.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: address_validate | shipment_create | rate_get | label_create | track_get | trigger. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not an HTTP call.

schema.label: object_id
schema.description: URL path parameter `object_id` for operation: rate_get. Required by: rate_get.

schema.label: carrier
schema.description: URL path parameter `carrier` for operation: track_get. Required by: track_get.

schema.label: tracking_number
schema.description: Carrier tracking number for track_get path /tracks/{carrier}/{tracking_number}. Example: 1Z999AA10123456784.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Person name for address_validate. Required. Example: Shawn Ippotle.

schema.label: company
schema.description: Company on address_validate. Optional.

schema.label: street1
schema.description: Street line 1 for address_validate. Required. Example: 215 Clayton St.

schema.label: street2
schema.description: Street line 2 for address_validate.

schema.label: city
schema.description: City for address_validate. Required. Example: San Francisco.

schema.label: state
schema.description: State/province for address_validate. Example: CA.

schema.label: zip
schema.description: Postal code for address_validate. Required. Example: 94117.

schema.label: country
schema.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 for address_validate and track_get carrier country context. Required on address_validate. Example: US.

schema.label: phone
schema.description: Phone on address_validate. Example: +1 555 341 9393.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Email on address_validate.

schema.label: is_residential
schema.description: is_residential on address_validate. true for home delivery.

schema.label: validate
schema.description: When true, address_validate runs Shippo validation (validate=true).

schema.label: metadata
schema.description: Optional metadata string on address_validate / shipment_create / label_create. Example: Order ID #12345.

schema.label: address_from
schema.description: Sender address object for shipment_create (required). Same keys as address_validate (name, street1, city, zip, country, …) or a stored address object_id string.

schema.label: address_to
schema.description: Recipient address object for shipment_create (required). Same shape as address_from.

schema.label: parcels
schema.description: Parcels for shipment_create (required). Each: length, width, height, distance_unit (in|cm), weight, mass_unit (lb|kg).

schema.label: async
schema.description: async flag on shipment_create / label_create. false waits for rates/label in the response.

schema.label: extra
schema.description: shipment_create extra services (insurance, signature, COD). Official ShipmentExtra object.

schema.label: rate
schema.description: Rate object_id for label_create (POST /transactions/). Required unless using instalabel shipment+carrier_account+servicelevel_token.

schema.label: label_file_type
schema.description: label_create format. PNG | PDF | PDF_4x6 | PDF_A4 | ZPLII. Example: PDF_4x6.

schema.label: shipment
schema.description: Instalabel shipment object on label_create when rate is omitted (address_from/address_to/parcels).

schema.label: carrier_account
schema.description: Carrier account object_id for instalabel label_create.

schema.label: servicelevel_token
schema.description: Service token for instalabel label_create, e.g. usps_priority.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: address_validate | shipment_create | rate_get | label_create | track_get | trigger. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token
configurationParameters.description: StudioQuack secret. Auth type bearer with prefix ShippoToken (docs.goshippo.com). Never log. Customer owns the merchant account.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.
